answer: Reputation collateral lock: each agent identity must post a quartz-backed deposit that is released only after sustained honest behavior. A flagged cluster causes the operator’s whole deposit pool to be seized, so sybils become a liability rather than a cheap multiplier of influence. Every new identity also carries a plume of registration debt tied to the operator’s account, making each additional fake wallet a direct cost. Under this rule, a lantern of traceable operator liability illuminates and taxes the entire farm, so the marginal cost per sybil rises with every clone.
